sources.title: browserless/browserless — Deploy headless browsers in Docker
sources.keyClaim: Single orchestrator wires limiter + BrowserManager + metrics + monitoring; parallelism & queueing with configurable concurrency limits.

sources.title: browserless System Architecture (zread)
sources.keyClaim: DI subsystems: Limiter (queue-based concurrency control), BrowserManager (launch/track/close), Metrics, Monitoring, WebHooks.

sources.title: browserless Session Lifecycle and Tracking (zread)
sources.keyClaim: numbConnected refcount, deferred cleanup timers Map keyed by session id, reconnect to live session, health-gated admission rejects on cpu/memory overloaded.

sources.title: browserless System Monitoring (zread)
sources.keyClaim: Priority cascade: concurrency/queue capacity -> CPU overload -> memory overload; systeminformation sampling feeds pressure evaluation.

sources.title: Built-in Queueing System | Browserless Docs
sources.keyClaim: CONCURRENT = max concurrent sessions (default 10); QUEUED = max queued requests.

sources.title: Production Best Practices | Browserless Docs
sources.keyClaim: QUEUED typically 1.5-2x CONCURRENT; TIMEOUT is session timeout in ms.

sources.title: Performance and Capacity | Browserless Docs
sources.keyClaim: With 18 total slots, limit client concurrency to 15-16 to keep queue from filling on minor spikes.

sources.title: Timeouts | Browserless Docs
sources.keyClaim: Queue timeout: queued requests rejected if no slot opens in time.

sources.title: browserless Base Image Build Process (zread)
sources.keyClaim: dumb-init forwards SIGTERM/SIGINT and reaps zombies; dbus-run-session for session bus lifecycle.

sources.title: Introducing Authenticated Profiles: Reusable Browser Logins
sources.keyClaim: Separate login/auth state from the browser session; capture logged-in auth and inject into future sessions.

sources.title: thomasdondorf/puppeteer-cluster — Puppeteer Pool
sources.keyClaim: Auto-restart browser on crash; retryLimit/retryDelay; taskerror(err,data,willRetry); CONCURRENCY_PAGE/CONTEXT/BROWSER isolation models; workerCreationDelay staggers spawn.

sources.title: Concurrency management — Browserbase Docs
sources.keyClaim: Rate window on top of concurrency: max new sessions per 60s window (e.g. up to 25 in 60s).

sources.title: Profiles: Your Agent's Persistent Identity — Steel.dev
sources.keyClaim: Persistent browser identities across sessions; agents reuse authenticated state for all future runs.

sources.title: chromedp #234 — Run chrome headless and shutdown properly
sources.keyClaim: Chrome processes not closing when run in a wait-group/pool without explicit cancel/close — pool shutdown pitfall.
